learnings: A production-style tool is small, focused modules: models, config, storage, reports and the CLI.
Layered configuration, SQLite migrations, logging, exit codes and packaging fit together into one product.
A branch-coverage gate above 90 % keeps the tool safe to change.
pitfalls: Mixing CLI parsing with business logic makes both hard to test – keep the logic in pure functions.
next: Course complete – continue with the roadmap in learning_develop.md.
